parameters.query: WITH target AS ( SELECT ctid FROM interview_feedback WHERE interview_id = $1 ORDER BY submitted_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ), updated AS ( UPDATE interview_feedback f SET technical_score = $2, communication_score = $3, cultural_fit_score = $4, overall_rating = $5, recommendation = $6, comments = $7, submitted_at = NOW() FROM target t WHERE f.ctid = t.ctid RETURNING f.* ) INSERT INTO interview_feedback (interview_id, technical_score, communication_score, cultural_fit_score, overall_rating, recommendation, comments, submitted_at) SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) RETURNING *;
SELECT i.id, i.candidate_email, i.candidate_name, i.round_label, i.round_number, i.job_title FROM interview_schedules i WHERE i.id = $1 LIMIT 1;
